rounds.text: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a DCF-derived margin of safety of 76% [E46]. The company demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency, boasting an ROE of 29.7% [E13] and an ROCE of 30.7% [E12], both of which vastly outperform their respective sector benchmarks [E9, E10]. This fundamental strength is further underscored by a valuation that is highly attractive, with a P/E of 9.73x [E1] compared to a sector benchmark of 16.99x [E6], and an EV/EBITDA of 8.15x against a sector benchmark of 11.03x [E11]. Management is signaling confidence in the business, as evidenced by an increase in promoter holdings to 57.47% [E41]. Conceded: the stock has experienced negative institutional money flow [E44], and recent quarterly operating margins have contracted by 3 percentage points [E31]. Despite these short-term headwinds, the company’s ability to generate Rs 39 Cr in free cash flow [E36] while maintaining a comfortable current ratio of 2.86x [E38] suggests a robust financial foundation that the market is currently failing to price in.
